description.en: Fine bookcloth weave and loose paper fibers, with shallow bookbinding impressions and generous quiet space.

design.motif: Orthographic continuous bookcloth and uncoated paper working surface, fine warp and weft, scattered paper fibers and shallow binding crease impressions. No botanical ornaments or literal books.
design.rationale: The owner-approved physical poetry book identity and Chinese poetry reader suggest bookbinding material, not animal habitat foliage.

description.en: Sparse small savanna tree leaflets and gently curved stems around a quiet paper-like field.
description.zh: 稀树草原的小叶与弯曲枝梗疏落在边缘，中央保留安静纸面。

design.motif: Broad plausible savanna habitat, small oval compound leaflets and slim curved woody stems concentrated at lower and right margins. No flowers, tropical monstera, animals or orange accent.
design.rationale: The approved rhinoceros identity does not establish an exact species. A broad savanna foliage analogy is plausible without a species-specific biological claim. The orange horn remains the only strong identity accent.
